messages:
Alex W: Quick heads-up — we have the staging->prod infra cutover tonight at 23:00 UTC. This includes the new peering routes and the IAM role split. Planning a staged apply: staging at 22:00 UTC, prod at 23:00 UTC. Deploybot will run the jobs.

Deploybot: scheduled: terraform-apply/staging at 2024-12-04T22:00:00Z (job id: jb-8821)

Maria P: Can we pin the AWS provider and the vpc-module to avoid drift during the cutover? Last time a minor provider bump changed behaviour.

Chris N: +1 to pinning. Also recommend we keep a manual hold between staging and prod until the canary traffic is verified.

Alex W: Agreed. Maria — can you push a tiny provider bump PR with the version locks? e.g. in root module:
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  version = "~> 4.70"
}
module "vpc" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/vpc-module//modules/core"
  version = "0.12.1"
}
```
We'll merge, run staging apply, validate, then cut prod.

Maria P: Working on the PR now. I'll also add a tfstate snapshot and attach the plan output to the release thread.

Leo T: For rollout, suggest a 10% traffic shadow for 15 minutes then 100% if no alarms. Canary target is only routing rules so should be fine.

Chris N: Escape hatch: if error rate or 5xxs increase by >2% or latency p50 increases >150ms on the canary, we stop and revert. Who's owner to trigger revert?

SRE Oncall: I'll be standing by. If thresholds hit, @SRE Oncall will run rollback plan. Revert will be: apply previous module version pin and re-run terraform apply with last-known-good plan. Keep rollback commands ready:
```bash
# rollback example
git checkout tags/v2024.11.3 && terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve /path/to/last-good.plan
```

Alex W: Good. Add the rollback steps to release notes and mark the release as "manual hold" between waves.

Maria P: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4812 — pins providers/modules and adds a preflight plan check.

Deploybot: plan succeeded for staging (jb-8821). Plan summary: 12 resources to add, 3 to change, 0 to destroy. Plan link: https://deploys.redwood/jobs/jb-8821/plan

Leo T: I'm ready to run the traffic shadow once staging looks clean.

Chris N: I'll watch metrics and have a quick script ready to flip the feature flag if needed.

Alex W: Final checklist: provider/module pins merged, staging apply ✅, canary shadow 10% 15m ✅, SRE oncall watching ✅, release notes updated with rollback commands ✅. If all good, prod apply at 23:00 UTC and cutover. :thumbsup:

Deploybot: prod apply scheduled: terraform-apply/prod at 2024-12-04T23:00:00Z (job id: jb-8822)

Maria P: Noted — I'll keep the PR open until after prod apply.

SRE Oncall: Oncall will monitor and post back within the thread on metrics during canary window.

Alex W: Thanks team — ping here if anything anomalous.

Chris N: small nit: add a note in the release notes to include which commit/hash the canary ran with. Saves hunting later.

Maria P: added commit hash to the PR description.

Deploybot: job jb-8822 queued (awaiting manual hold release).
